title: Length bound for a filtered query
statement: Let $f$ assign a finite word to each natural number, let $p$ be a predicate on the natural numbers, and let $t$ be a natural number. Suppose that for every $s<t$, the length of $f(s)$ is at most $s$. Every word $z$ that appears among the words $f(s)$ selected by $p(s)$ for $s<t$ has length at most $t$.
hypotheses_covered: A function from natural numbers to finite words
For every $s<t$, the length of $f(s)$ is at most $s$
$z$ belongs to the filtered list of selected words for indices below $t$
